name: An Unfortunate End
label: Quest
description: An Unfortunate End: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The deceased Night Watchman lying before you is covered in deep gashes and cuts. It's clear to see that he was mauled by some sort of large beast.

You notice that the corpse has an unlit torch in his hand. You reach down and pry it from his stiff fingers. This could be useful in your travels through Duskwood and beyond to reveal things hidden by darkness.

sources.title: Forever's own quest text, captured in game
